programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Three month old rescue puppy Tyson is being fostered by a family for just one week. But when foster Mum, Melissa takes the puppy to Chris for a routine check up she is confronted with terrible news. Tyson needs major heart surgery or he will die. Despite the expense, the family decide to adopt Tyson because they know no one else will give him a home in his condition. Will Tyson survive the openheart surgery and have a happy future with his new family?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris has rushed to the Australian Reptile Park to handle an emergency. Two Tasmanian devil babies, Lara and Lily have been struck down with a mystery illness and are close to death. Can Chris save the two critically ill sisters or is the entire devil population at the park in danger of being wiped out?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Two boxer puppies are found by police wandering the streets. One has been hit by a car and is coughing up blood. Chris is called to rescue the brothers. First, he must treat the hit run victim but then it becomes his mission to track down their owners and prevent them going to an animal shelter. The trouble is Chris is bonding with the puppies and is going to find it hard to let go.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A miniature horse who is suffering from dwarfism disease was not meant to survive past six months. However his loving owner and a dedicated band of vets have beaten the odds and kept 2 year old Koda alive. Australia’s smallest horse is also a regular visitor at the Royal Children’s Hospital in Melbourne and lights up the lives of hundreds of sick kids. Now, however, the brave Koda faces another life threatening operation. Chris will be part of the elite surgical team that will decide Koda’s fate.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Two heartbroken little girls and their Mum are pleading for Dr Chris to save their beloved bunny. The family came home to find something shocking had happened to little Alice. The rabbit is the girls’ first pet and only 14 weeks old. This will be one of Dr Chris’ toughest cases.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A beautiful kelpie is brought to Chris in a terrible state. A knock to the head as a puppy has caused severe balance problems but his condition is now deteriorating rapidly. His loving owner Heidi already has a baby to look after but she is constantly assisting Jasper and cannot bear the thought of losing him. In desperation, she looks to Chris for an answer. A brain scan shows his problems are inoperable but Chris refuses to give in. A custom made cart is fitted for Jasper and the sight of him moving about with his new “ wheels” is a heart warming salute to love and persistence.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Jen brings in her son’s dog Jewel to Dr Chris to find out if she’s expecting. The complication? This is an unplanned pregnancy and Jen suspects the father is her own dog, Token. X rays prove Jewel is having a football team of puppies. Get ready for a long night of anxiety, sadness and ultimately joy as Dr Chris helps Jewel through her ordeal. Funny scenes as proud father, Token keeps a close eye on proceedings to make sure his offspring are being well looked after.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A beautiful pig is about to become pork chops if she keeps digging up the family property with her broken nose ring. Her owner, Allison loves Lola and has asked Chris to find a way to stop the execution. A new nose ring is the answer. Sounds easy but sedating an angry pig turns out to be a tough challenge. Watch out for some hilarious chase scenes.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Honey has taken a death-defying leap out of a car doing 40 kms an hour to chase down a cat. Somehow the spoodle has survived but just how serious are her injuries? Owner, Ilana is suffering enormous guilt that she didn’t have the family’s pride and joy safety strapped in the car. Watch for the cat hating spoodle’s reaction when she hears her archenemies out the back of the Bondi clinic.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris finally has a weekend off vet duties and is heading to Newcastle to catch up with his parents. But a call from his dad about a bizarre snake emergency sends him on a fascinating detour. What has the huge python swallowed that is now threatening to kill him? This a case of truth being stranger then fiction.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A game of chasey at home turns ugly for Hooligan when he runs into his owner, Sarah. Hooligan’s horribly fractured leg needs major surgery at Sash but the tiny terrier has never spent a night away from his family and is not coping.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is about to be confronted with the smallest patient he has ever handled. Twelve-year old Elliot’s much-loved pet mouse, Pinot has developed a massive, cancerous tumour. But surgery on such a pint-sized patient is going to be a real challenge. Will Pinot pull through or will a young girl be shattered?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Homer the turtle is going on holidays while his owner is overseas. What can go wrong? Well ...try finding the little fellow in the fangs of the resident pooch. Babysitter Jody is guilt ridden and the traumatised Homer is the victim of a big bacteria bite. Can Chris save the day for everyone?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris heads to the Victorian high country to help out a mate and to realise a boyhood dream of becoming a vet in the bush. It’s a challenging week as he treats everything from horses to wombats and monkeys and helps save a mother in trouble. Monkeys carry some nasty diseases and watch for Chris’ concerns about what he might leave Mansfield with. Talk about a dangerous job.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Pearl was at her regular hairdressing appointment when she started bleeding internally. Now the pampered poodle may have minutes to live and Chris is her only hope.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Little Lucu has been attacked by a paralysis tick and the poison is rapidly shutting down her system. A round the clock watch is needed to keep this innocent victim alive. But will it be enough?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A bizarre looking baby cockatoo has fallen twenty metres out of her nest and wants to alert the whole world to her plight. Can Chris help the little screamer and will she ever be able to fly?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: An emotional case for Chris as he fights to save one of the clinic’s favourite patients. Beautiful Bluebell was dumped on the doorstep of the clinic as a kitten and adopted out to a loving family. Now Bluebell is the victim of a hit run accident and all the staff at Bondi are directly affected.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: The Australian Reptile Park operations manager, Tim Faulkner ropes Chris into a frightening mission in far north Queensland. A monster seven metre python called Big Mamma is living in the roof of a local boating club and the female paddlers are terrified. It’s all up to the intrepid duo as they head to Cairns to try to capture the scary reptile.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A quick thinking police officer in Sydney’s infamous King Cross has rescued a twelve-week old puppy and rushed her into the Bondi clinic. The puppy was found sweltering in forty degree heat in a plastic handbag and the culprit has been arrested. Little Tilly soon finds a place in Chris’ heart and home where she has a confrontation with the resident cat, George. Without a microchip, the search is on for her owner.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A morning walk has gone tragically wrong for Tigger and his distressed owner Bernadette. A street cleaner spooked the five year old and sent him charging into a car. Chris is trying to calm them both down to find out the extent of Tigger’s injuries.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Ziggy is a dog with an embarrassing problem. A huge mass is hanging off his back leg. Bemused vet nurse Neil tells us its like “ a third testicle swinging in the wind.” But when it comes to surgery it’s no laughing matter for Chris.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Boris the Staffy was born with a cleft palate. Lucky to survive, he has now endured seven operations to try to fix the gaping hole in his mouth. All have failed and time is running out. Chronic infections are now destroying his quality of life. Like Boris, his owner Jess is refusing to give up. She’s written to Chris looking for one last chance. The surgery will be the first of its type ever performed in Australia. Eight thousand dollars needs to be raised and Chris is prepared to go all the way for Boris!

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: West Highland terrier, Chester lives in Bondi but has a fanatical hatred of skateboarders. It’s a dangerous combination and one that is making life hell for his owners Mark and Jess. They’re worried Chester could bite someone and end up in serious trouble. What can Dr Chris come up with to tame the savage terrier?

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is spending 2 weeks volunteering at the busy Esther Honey vet clinic in the Cook Islands. This week his first patient is a much loved cat called Small One, which has part of its nose missing. Chris is immediately concerned that Small One may have a skin cancer.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris makes a special trip to Karara in Queensland to see Stubby, a tiny 3-week-old piglet, born with only one trotter. Stubby is struggling to get around. If the brave little battler is to survive, Chris needs to work out a way for her to walk normally.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris travels to Edgars Mission on the outskirts of Melbourne, where he is faced with a very woolly fugitive. Ben Hall is a sheep that was rescued after 5 years on the run, and Chris is shocked at the condition of his heavy coat. The thick, matted wool could be hiding all sorts of health problems.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is visiting remote Christmas Island where he has to help a seabird named Bill that is unable to fly. Bill is a rare Abbott’s Booby, and she's missing critical flight feathers. Chris needs to treat Bill's deformed wing, before starting rehabilitation with the young rescue bird.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Tim wants Chris to find out why Jack the koala has suddenly developed nasty bumps all over his face. Chris is so concerned, they take the little 2 year old to the local clinic for an immediate biopsy. When the results come back Tim is astonished to learn that Jack has acne.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A dairy buffalo called Penny has severely deformed horns, which are growing into her skull, dangerously close to her brain. Chris has to try to corral the timid 10 year old, and then carry out the painstaking job of carefully removing the horns.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is heading out to sea, to help try to save an endangered Grey Nurse shark, which has been spotted entangled in fishing line and with a hook stuck in its mouth. A specialist rescue team has been assembled and Chris is joining them in the water, to try to corral the injured shark so it can be brought to the surface.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is helping out at the Marlin Coast veterinary hospital in Cairns. His first patient is a young dog which has had a nasty encounter with a hedgecutter. Misty has ended up with deep cuts across her nose. How the young dog avoided more disastrous injuries is a miracle.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Chris is helping out at the Marlin Coast veterinary hospital in Cairns, and his first patient is a rare Fijian iguana Called Ako. The Iguana hasn't been himself, and isn't eating properly. Chris needs to do an x-ray to try to work out what's going on. The results reveal a massive bladder stone inside the small animal, and he needs immediate surgery.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: A little joey has been brought in to Chris at the Bondi clinic after its mother was hit and killed by a car. It's feared the frail orphan may have a broken leg, but carer Sandy is determined to give the little battler a chance. It's a huge challenge for Chris to try to repair the leg. It's a heart stopping moment when he finds if the risky surgery has been a success.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Andrew investigates a worrying lump on a horse for a possible killer disease, but can he get close enough to find out. And Doctor Rachel is feeling the pressure when a passionate wildlife warrior brings in two distressed little Aussies.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Romi faces multiple emergencies when Lucy the groodle crashes before and during surgery, and Andrew treats a seriously ill goat that could be infested with a life-threatening parasite.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: Andrew must make a life and death decision on a close friend’s pet cow. Rachel investigates why a friendly young Labrador has developed a worrying limp, but can she calm her terrified patient down enough to even treat him.

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: On this episode a critically ill kangaroo infant has Andrew and the young joey’s rescuer worried for its life. Dr Romi has her hand full with eight lively puppies, but will they get a clean bill of health?

programme.title: Country Vet Practice
programme.desc: On this episode delicate surgery has Andrew anxious for Sally the cow’s future. And why is doctor Romi so over the moon?

programme.title: Bondi Vet ER
programme.desc: Alex and Gerardo team up to save a greedy groodle that swallowed a tube of glue, Brooke battles a large bone stuck deep inside a dog’s throat and a tiny kitten is rushed in after a play session with the family dog goes horribly wrong.

programme.desc: On this episode of Bondi Vet ER Luna has been rushed in to Alex with shocking injuries, Gerardo desperately tries to save a new born puppy, and a sock has gone missing and Ollie is facing serious trouble.

programme.desc: Billy answers an SOS from farmers in North Queensland who have lost chickens to a giant snake. Rob performs surgery on a German Shepherd with a broken leg. Michael removes a strange growth from a beloved African pygmy hedgehog .

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jeff Gustafson
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the 2023 Bassmaster Classic, watch Jeff Gustafson's dominant performance as he wins for the second time on Fort Loudoun and Tellico. programme.title: Peak Performance - CliffPrince
programme.desc: Watch Cliff Prince's winning week at Wheeler Lake in this edition of the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament. Prince found a magical spot where the fishing was on fire the first two hours of every tournament day and it lasted all four days en route to his first blue trophy on the Bassmaster Elite Series. The area was 4 to 5 feet deep and Prince maintained a low profile and fished his chatterbait around grass and over a hard spot without using his forward facing sonar.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brandon Palaniuk
programme.desc: In this Marathon Peak Performance, we take a look at Brandon Palaniuk's amazing 2022 season en route to his second Angler of the Year title.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Jason Christie
programme.desc: Jason Christie led three days of the Elite Series event at the Sabine River and rode a great two days of fishing to the winners circle in his return year to the Bassmaster Elites. He is the Marathon Peak Performance at the Sabine.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Brandon Lester
programme.desc: ‪@BrandonLesterFishing‬ fished a flawless week at Pickwick Lake for the 6th stop of the 2022 Bassmaster Elite Series season. Lester took the title and won his first Elite Series title and his second B.A.S.S. win this year. Congratulations to Lester, the Marathon Peak Performance at Pickwick.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Tyler Rivet
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance from Lake Okeechobee, follow Tyler Rivet as he closes in on his first Bassmaster Elite Series title. Rivet is a 5th year Elite Series pro who started his career in college at Nicholls State where he formed a Bass Team and fished in every Bassmaster National Championship during his five years in school.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Austin Felix
programme.desc: Austin Felix had an impeccable smallmouth record in Bassmaster Elite Series events prior to Lake Oahe, but the Minnesota pro went to another level after four successful days in South Dakota. In the Marathon Peak Performance at Lake Oahe, watch Austin Felix take home his first tour-level victory with Bassmaster.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Bryant Schmitt
programme.desc: Bryan Schmitt is one of the winningest anglers in professional fishing and his great track record is noted on grassy river fisheries. Schmitt ended 2022 with a big victory on the Mighty Mississippi River in La Crosse, Wisconsin. Watch his stellar week in the Marathon Peak Performance of the tournament.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Trey Mckinney
programme.desc: One week after turning 19 years old, Trey McKinney became the youngest Bassmaster Elite Series Champion after landing 130 pounds, 15 ounces at Lake Fork for the 2nd stop of the season. Watch his week unfold in this Marathon Peak Performance feature.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Joey Cifuentes
programme.desc: First year Bassmaster Elite Series pro Joey Cifuentes dominated the Lake Seminole Elite event and took his first pro-level victory. Cifuentes outlasted the field with a four-day total of 85 pounds, 2 ounces. In this Marathon Peak Performance you can watch his winning week.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Justin Hammer
programme.desc: ‪@justinhamnerfishing‬ followed his passion and that dream led him to the Bassmaster Elite Series. After a few years on the Elites, he was in the catbird seat of the 2024 Bassmaster Classic where his lifelong dream came true and he became the World Champion of bass fishing. Watch his week unfold at Grand Lake O' the Cherokees in Oklahoma.

programme.title: Peak Performance - Lee Livesay
programme.desc: Walk on the wild side with Lee Livesay and his entire week at Lake Fork as he looked to go back to back on his home lake. Livesay was the local favorite with the most amount of knowledge at Lake Fork, but sometimes that can bite you. In the Marathon Peak Performance of the Event, Livesay wins his third Elite Series title and fourth overall Bassmaster victory in just a span of 18 months.

programme.title: Peak Performance -Patrick Walters
programme.desc: In the Marathon Peak Performance at the St. Lawrence River, watch as Patrick Walters wins his 2nd Elite Series victory and breaks the 100-pound mark for the 3rd time in his career.

programme.desc: Ed Loughran, who is also a practicing attorney, notched his biggest fishing achievement by winning the Bassmaster Elite Series event at Lake Champlain. Bryant Bailey is not Indy's type - she's never been into guys like him. But then again, she's never really known anyone so stubborn and caring that can also help her discover who she is and what she's worth. A modern telling of Cinderella, based on the novel by Jenni James.

After being denied the funding needed to refurbish the ranch, she is reintroduced to her ex-boyfriend Josh, a big-time marketing executive stationed in Denver who has been suspended from his current position at his company. Admitting to herself that she needs the help, Paisley agrees to work with Josh while he is town to come up with ideas on how to raise money for the farm.

Alice accepts the invitation despite the dismay of BRETT, her boss who is also her boyfriend. Once she gets to Kansas, Alice is surprised to find her former boyfriend in college, CHRISTIAN (Scot cooper), is amongst the judges. The cooking show and her reconnection with Christian will make Alice reconsider her calling and make her dreams come true.

programme.desc: Josh e Cornelia, um casal sem filhos começa a passar mais tempo com um jovem casal de hipsters. Um jovem aspirante a documentarista, uma vocação que ações Josh. Logo o casal mais velho começa a desfrutar da energia transmitida pela geração mais jovem, mas, eventualmente, Josh começa a suspeitar que seu novo melhor amigo pode não ser tão honesto e confiável como o esperado.

programme.title: Cerca Al Enemigo
programme.desc: En lo profundo de un bosque en la frontera entre Estados Unidos y Canadá, dos enemigos deben trabajar juntos para escapar de un despiadado cártel de la droga empeñado en recuperar un cargamento de droga que desapareció allí.

programme.title: O Retorno do Dragão, A Cidade Perdida
programme.desc: Três anos após os eventos de Dragon Inn, a estalajadeira Jade desapareceu e uma nova estalagem surgiu das cinzas – uma estalagem administrada por saqueadores disfarçados de cidadãos cumpridores da lei, que esperam desenterrar a lendária cidade perdida enterrada no deserto.

programme.title: A Estrada 47
programme.desc: Na segunda Guerra Mundial, o Brasil enviou soldados para combater os alemães no norte da Itália. Durante a madrugada, uma esquadra brasileira sofre um ataque de pânico.

programme.title: Hitman - O Rei dos Assassinos
programme.desc: Um antigo chefe da máfia japonesa suspeita de ser vítima de um ataque e deixa uma recompensa para a pessoa que encontrar o seu assassino. Então, um assassino contratado e um golpista decidem juntos buscar o enigmático "Rei dos Assassinos " e ganhar o prêmio cobiçado.

programme.title: American Sicario
programme.desc: O gângster americano Erik Vasquez está planejando se tornar o principal chefe do submundo mexicano, apenas para se ver fazendo inimigos tanto dos poderosos cartéis quanto de seus próprios aliados.

programme.title: O Último Viking
programme.desc: Um jovem Viking chamado Vitharr chega à Grã-Bretanha com sonhos de conquista e aventura, mas quando sua família e clã são emboscados e mortos, ele deve sobreviver sozinho nesta terra nova e estranha enquanto procura o assentamento de seu tio.

programme.title: O Garoto de Oro
programme.desc: Um ex-campeão de luta livre da NCAA está em liberdade condicional após cumprir 10 anos de prisão. Agora, para salvar a vida de um amigo, ele concorda em participar de uma luta extrema. No entanto, ele é desafiado a fazer o impossível: perder.

programme.title: A Vilã
programme.desc: Desde pequena, Sook-hee foi treinada para se tornar uma assassina. Quando é recrutada como agente secreta, ela tem uma nova oportunidade de trabalhar por 10 anos e ganhar sua liberdade. Sua nova identidade é ser atriz de teatro. Para alguém que viveu uma vida de assassinatos, levar uma vida normal não é fácil. Mas logo eles descobrirão os segredos de seu passado.

programme.title: Mentes Malignas
programme.desc: Um filme antológico na forma de longa-metragem de horror. Estes segmentos assustadores são recheados de personagens conhecidos como mitos, tradições e contos populares. Criadas para dar lógica aos medos mais sombrios da humanidade, essas histórias lançaram as bases para o que hoje conhecemos como gênero de terror.

programme.title: Perseguido pelo Destino
programme.desc: Em um circuito de corridas, o gângster Gigi (Matthias Schoenaerts), membro de uma cruel gangue criminosa de Bruxelas, conhece a jovem e rica corredora Bibi (Adèle Exarchopoulos). Logo, os dois se apaixonam, mas por causa de suas vidas distintas, a chance de ficarem juntos é remota. Mesmo assim, eles iniciam um relacionamento pelo qual lutarão com unhas e dentes, mas que também colocará suas vidas em perigo.

programme.title: Presos no gelo
programme.desc: Jotunheimen, Noruega. Nesse impressionante cenário nevado, cinco amigos se reúnem para praticar snowboard. Pouco depois de começar, um deles sofre uma grave fratura na perna. A noite cai, o carro está longe, não há ajuda por perto e seus telefones estão sem sinal.

programme.title: Presos no Gelo 3
programme.desc: Na década de 1980, um grupo de adolescentes explora um hotel abandonado. Logo, um assassino psicótico começa a persegui-los pela floresta norueguesa.

programme.title: Sono Mortal
programme.desc: Uma jovem deve salvar a si mesma e seus amigos a partir de um antigo mal, que persegue suas vítimas através do fenômeno da vida real de paralisia do sono.

programme.title: O Mal está Lá Fora
programme.desc: Um xerife faz uma descoberta estranha quando ele está é chamado a um pomar onde três irmãs adolescentes foram atacadas por um bando de jovens delinquentes.

programme.title: História de um Assassinato
programme.desc: Vera (Sienna Miller), uma famosa atriz de Nova York, deixa seu ex-namorado problemático (Nick Matthews) entrar em seu apartamento. As coisas se complicam quando ele decide atacá-la

programme.title: Noites em Claro
programme.desc: Alex e Penny estão fartos da vida agitada da cidade e decidem se mudar para o campo para criar seu filho recém-nascido. Mas eles não imaginam os horrores que ameaçam seu relacionamento e sua família.

programme.title: Acoso del más alla
programme.desc: Marnie Watson sale en libertad condicional. La mujer fue condenada por asesinar su marido, un violento policía que la maltrataba diariamente. Marnie debe pasar un año en arresto domiciliario portando un localizador electrónico. Por si esto no fuera poco, su marido se ha convertido en un fantasma que habita la casa y que está sediento de venganza

programme.desc: Gintas é o chefe de polícia em uma pacata cidade do interior e membro da elite local. Mas, quando um assassino começa a semear a morte entre esse grupo privilegiado, Gintas deve não apenas liderar a investigação, mas também lutar para proteger a própria vida.

programme.title: COPYCAT A VIDA IMITA A MORTE
programme.desc: Uma detetive tenta tirar uma psicóloga criminal do isolamento para ajudar a capturar um assassino que reproduz os crimes dos mais notórios serial killers da história.

programme.desc: Margaret está fazendo de tudo para esquecer sua casa, e a vida noturna de Tóquio, regada a bebidas, drogas e amantes, a ajuda nisso.

programme.desc: Nas profundezas da floresta, um caminhante perdido encontra a cabana de um velho errático e recluso. O que começa como uma conversa cordial logo se torna perigoso quando fica claro que um deles — ou ambos — pode estar escondendo um segredo aterrorizante.

programme.title: NAVIO DE SANGUE
programme.desc: Em algum lugar do Atlântico Norte, no final de 1945, uma balsa salva-vidas flutua à deriva. Sem comida, água ou abrigo, tudo parece perdido — até que uma embarcação nazista abandonada surge ameaçadoramente diante deles.

Er macht dann den Fehler, ihr nachzugeben, als sie darauf besteht, den Grund zu hören. Währenddessen beißt sich Elaine auf die Zunge, während sich Kramers wilde Romanze mit ihrer Zimmergenossin aufheizt.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Jerry und Elaine besuchen Jerrys Eltern in Florida, wo Jerrys Vater von seiner Eigentümergemeinschaft geehrt wird. Beim Abendessen bewundert Jerry einen speziellen Astronautenstift, der einem der Vereinsmitglieder gehört. Als Jerry ihn als Geschenk annimmt, löst er einen Spannungsberg bei seinen Eltern aus, die meinen, Jerry hätte ablehnen sollen.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Jerry sitzt zu Hause fest, als er sich zum Hundesitten eines streitlustigen Hundes überreden lässt. Ohne Jerry haben George und Elaine nur wenig gemeinsam. In der Zwischenzeit besteht Kramer darauf, dass es das absolute Ende für ihn und seine Freundin ist und dass er die Beziehung beenden wird.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Jerry und seine Freunde verirren sich in einem Parkhaus.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Die Bibliothek kontaktiert Jerry wegen eines überfälligen Buches aus dem Jahr 1971. Laut Kramer könnten sich die Kosten bei einer Geldstrafe von 5 Cent pro Tag für 20 Jahre auf 50.000 US-Dollar belaufen. In einer Rückblende zu der Zeit, als Jerry und George noch Teenager in der High School waren, versucht Jerry, sich genau zu erinnern, wann er das betreffende Buch zurückgegeben hat.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Als Jerry bemerkt, dass nur wenige Leute in einem gewissen Nachbarschaftscafé zum Essen anhalten, hat er Mitleid mit dem Besitzer und hält an, um Möglichkeiten zur Steigerung des Geschäfts vorzuschlagen - wodurch das Restaurant noch schlechter läuft. In der Zwischenzeit willigt George ein, im Rahmen des Forschungsprojekts seiner Freundin einen IQ-Test durchzuführen, und befürchtet dann, dass sie herausfinden wird, dass er nicht so schlau ist, wie er es behauptet hat.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Jerry versucht verzweifelt, die mysteriöse Frau zu identifizieren, die anonym unartige Andeutungen in das Tonbandgerät geflüstert hat, mit dem er seine Stand-Up-Comedy-Nummer aufgenommen hat. Aber als Elaine George anvertraut, dass es ihre Stimme war, sieht George sie in einem sinnlicheren Licht! In der Hoffnung, sie zu beeindrucken, besorgt er sich einen alten chinesischen Trank, der Haarwachstum garantiert.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Jerry ist zwischen seiner Libido und seinem Hirn hin- und hergerissen, als er darüber debattiert, ob er weiterhin mit einer sexy, hinreißenden - aber egozentrischen und witzlosen - Schauspielerin ausgehen soll. Währenddessen kann George nicht anders, als auf die ungewöhnlich große Nase einer ansonsten attraktiven Frau zu starren, mit der er sich trifft.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Kaum hat Elaine Jerry von den Vorzügen eines Dates mit einem älteren Mann erzählt, beschließt sie, sich von ihrem 66-jährigen Verehrer zu trennen - eine Trennung, die noch komplizierter wird, als er vor Jerrys Wohnung einen Herzinfarkt erleidet. Zu allem Überfluss versagt George auch noch bei seinem neuen Job, Autos zu parken - was den Verkehr und einen herannahenden Krankenwagen blockiert.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Jerry verursacht versehentlich Elaines Trennung von ihrem Freund, einem trockenen Alkoholiker, als dieser wieder anfängt zu trinken. George zeigt Elaine seine Dankbarkeit dafür, dass sie ihm einen Job gefunden hat, indem er ihr einen preisreduzierten Kaschmirpullover kauft, in der Hoffnung, dass sie den kleinen Schönheitsfehler im Stoff nicht bemerkt.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Jerry sorgt sich, dass sein unheimlicher Nachbar aus dem Koma erwacht und herausfindet, dass er mit der leidenschaftlichen Freundin des Kranken ausgegangen ist. Unterdessen ist Elaine nach dem Fasten zur Vorbereitung auf einen Magengeschwür-Test verrückt vor Hunger, und George verschiebt einen Urlaub in der Karibik, um einen Hellseher wegen seiner Angst vor einem Flugzeugabsturz zu konsultieren.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Elaine überredet Jerry, einen Freund einzustellen, der als Studentenjob Wohnungen putzt. Als eine Statue vermisst wird, verdächtigt er den Studenten. Aber Jerry ist sich nicht sicher, wie er damit umgehen soll, sie zurückzubekommen.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: George, immer schon ein Hypochonder, glaubt, er habe einen Herzinfarkt und sucht auf Kramers Drängen hin den Rat eines 'ganzheitlichen' Heilers.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: George plant, sich an seinem Chef zu rächen, nachdem er gefeuert wurde; Jerry und Kramer nehmen einen Wäschereibesitzer ins Visier, den sie des Diebstahls verdächtigen.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Jerry en Elaine stellen nieuwe regels op voor hun relatie.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Um eine Massage der Spitzenklasse kostenlos zu erhalten, bittet Jerry seinen Zahnarztfreund, ein Schreiben zu unterschreiben, in dem steht, dass Jerry, George und Elaine aus medizinischen Gründen eine Behandlung durch einen zertifizierten Physiotherapeuten benötigen. Als der Arzt später des Versicherungsbetrugs verdächtigt wird, muss Jerry einen Weg finden, um den Ruf und die Karriere seines Freundes zu retten.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into a tragic story that spanned several decades, shattered lives and left one person behind bars. Fourteen children were held captive by a man who called himself The Messiah … a man who was also their father. Jeanne says she was raised in this environment, which the authorities called cult-like, and that she and her siblings were starved, beaten and had no schooling. In a tear-jerking revelation, Jeanne tells Dr. Phil that she was forced to perform unthinkable sexual acts with her own father, beginning when she was just 5 years old and ending when she was 27. Jeanne may be a victim of horrible cruelty, but her sisters, Miriam and Sarah, say they can’t forgive her for the pain she caused them. Find out why these siblings are estranged, and why Sarah says she’s nervous just sitting next to Jeanne on Dr. Phil’s stage. It’s been 20 years since Jeanne’s father was arrested, but she and her family say the effects of abuse still linger. Can these siblings ever get closure on their horrific past?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Stay-at-home mom Jessica claims her soon-to-be ex-husband of 23 years, Mike, is a narcissist who controls everything in her and their teenage daughters’ lives, especially the finances. Sixteen-year-old Chloe and 18-year-old Zoey say the worst thing he did was to shatter their dreams of becoming professional dancers in New York City. But Mike claims Jessica is putting the girls in the middle of their fight and brainwashing them to hate him. Dr. Phil tells Mike and Jessica what every couple needs to do with children when their marriage falls apart.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Who will Brad choose: his wife or girlfriend?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents express frustration with their twin sons' disrespectful behavior.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is there an adult under your roof, eating your food and taking advantage of you financially? If yes, then you live with a moocher! It's time to stop the enabling and start the accountability.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Phyllis and Barry say they're desperate to calm their violent 15-year-old son, Brandon, and turn to Dr. Phil for help. Their requests for Brandon to perform simple tasks such as brushing his teeth or bathing cause him to go into a rage, breaking things and punching holes in walls, and even chasing Phyllis with scissors. Barry says they walk on eggshells, waiting for Brandon’s next violent outburst and that every day he leaves the house worried that his wife may not be alive when he returns. What is at the root of Brandon's anger? Dr. Phil spends some one-on-one time with the young man to determine what’s driving his behavior. And, find out what Phyllis recently found in Brandon’s room that shocked her to her core.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Children accuse their dad of neglect.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: One-time high school sweethearts Tracey and Doug started having marriage problems when Doug admitted to having an affair with a transgender female, Essence.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Darcy says that her sister, Jennifer’s, home is in a state of complete chaos. She says Jennifer and her husband, Ralph, have no rules, their kitchen is bare, the electricity is often shut off, and they put their needs ahead of those of their four children -- who are acting out as a result. Darcy says her nephews, 8 and 10, smoke marijuana, play with weapons and recently started a local forest fire -- and that the 10-year-old once wrote a note asking for someone to kill him in his sleep. She says her 12-year-old niece was recently called to truancy court, and her 16-year-old niece is having unprotected sex in the home with her older, live-in boyfriend. Ralph concedes that he’s struggling to provide for his family financially and has made mistakes as a parent, but says Jennifer is to blame, claiming she’s checked out as a mother. Jennifer admits she’s detached from her family, struggles with depression and has trouble maintaining the household. With this family in dire need of a resolution, Dr. Phil stages a no-nonsense intervention. Are Jennifer and Ralph willing to take the necessary steps to save their family?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents are concerned about the extreme measures their daughters take to get and keep a boyfriend.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you have someone in your life who's so annoying and frustrating that you just want him or her to go away? What do you do when you're co-parents with someone you can't get along with? And, what if your daughter secretly dated, and then married, a man you despise?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Mom Needs to Cut the Cord
programme.desc: Samantha and her sister Sarah say their mother, Stacy, is very successful as a special education teacher and behaviorist, but hey claim their mother has allowed their 33 year old brother Ben to live rent free for the past 2 years, while he lays by the pool. Stacy’s husband, Doug, says he moved out and refuses to come home until Stacy kicks his stepson out of the house. Ben insists he is not taking advantage of his mother’s hospitality and kindness; he is just stuck in a rut.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Statistics show that 2,000 teens get pregnant every day. Moms and dads: Watch this show with your teenagers, because it can impact their lives and yours! Two families face off over who should raise baby Miley. Paige, 17, and her boyfriend, Jordan, 18, are determined to raise their child on their own, even though they live with Jordan’s dad, Chris. Nikki, Paige’s stepmom, thinks she and her husband should raise the child, because they can better provide for her, and she wants Paige to break up with Jordan. Why does she believe that Jordan is brainwashing Paige? The teen dad says Nikki is the one who’s controlling, and he’s stepped up to the plate. Will the families come to an agreement? See what Dr. Phil tells them they must do to ensure Miley grows up in a healthy environment. Plus, find out the 10 things teens want their parents to know about teen sex.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Christina and Jim are divorced, and their 21-year-old daughter, Tara, is living with her dad and his new wife who just happens to be the same age as Tara. Christina claims Jim was a horrible husband and a narcissist and she was forced to walk away from the family when Tara was just 13. Since then, she says Jim has let Tara get away with anything and now even allows her to work as a webcam model in order to help pay the bills! She says he is turning their daughter into a raging, angry monster with low self-esteem.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parents Liz and Jim say their 16-year-old son, Nic, has a serious drug problem that has such a hold on him, they claim he even stole $75,000 in gold from his parents’ safe and spent it all on drugs! But, Liz says she is convinced that her husband is to blame. Liz accuses Jim of being a narcissist and misogynist, whose parenting philosophy is based on intimidation and abuse, and claims that is what drove their son to drugs. Jim denies Liz’s allegations, claiming she has gone to great lengths to paint him as a villain. He says she is the major problem, and calls her the world's lousiest parent and a doormat who helped enable Nic's deadly addictions.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: The Girl Who Shot Me in the Face
programme.desc: Shot in the face, disfigured for life, the former teen victim comes face to face with the girl who pulled the trigger. Can she forgive?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: Our Son is a Violent Mooch
programme.desc: A couple want to evict their violent 31-year-old son, while their son blames his parents for his financial struggles.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Meet a “runaway bride” who’s already called off five weddings and she’s only 26! Then, meet another guest who’s frustrated because her fiancé won’t set a wedding date. He's canceled two previous engagements and says marriage "freaks him out." What does the future hold for these two? Plus, a heartbroken woman whose fiancé called the wedding off a month before her big day. Should she wait for him to come around? Find out what every bride needs to know before walking down the aisle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many women are itching to run to the altar, but Dr. Phil’s guests say they’re ready to run for the hills! Kelly is a self-proclaimed runaway bride. She’s been engaged four times but says she gets cold feet before she makes it down the aisle. Rick, her current fiancé, proposed four years ago and is still waiting for her to set a wedding date. Kelly believes that most marriages end in divorce, and she doesn’t want to become another statistic. Should Rick wait for her to make up her mind, or should he cut his losses and move on? Then, Chad and Candi have been engaged for over five years and have two daughters, but Chad says he’s not ready to tie the knot. He says weddings are too expensive, but Candi says he racked up $49,000 in loans for a car, a camper and a new deck for the house. Will Chad break down and give his fiancée the wedding of her dreams? Plus, Dr. Phil talks to a woman who says her fiancé left her six days before the wedding and stuck her with a $150,000 bill -- an allegation he totally denies.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Teen Can’t Stand Her Stepfather
programme.desc: When he last appeared on Dr. Phil, Kip’s brazen and outrageous tirade toward his 17-year-old stepdaughter, Tory, shocked audience members and viewers. But the married father of two refused to back down. When Tory broke down in tears, Kip finally agreed to find a calmer way to express his frustration. Just weeks later, Tory’s mother, Vicky, says the surly relationship has not only gotten worse, the hostility has escalated, and her patience is running thin. She says both Tory and Kip refuse to seek help, and now there is a new bombshell that is making their home life virtually unbearable. What does Kip say is his biggest issue with his stepdaughter? And, will this family finally agree to accept help and repair what’s left of their relationship? Then, Joe, 34, became an instant father to two teenage daughters. One of the girls has run away, and the other feels that he treats her like a slave. Can they resolve their disputes and come together as one? (FOLLOW UP FROM 9093)

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Contemporary weddings have turned into five-star productions, with couples pulling out all the stops to shine on their special day. But what happens when the bride or groom-to-be starts making diva-like demands? Mike and Jamie agreed to a small Vegas wedding, but that went out the window when Jamie switched her gown three times, rented a limo to drive her one block and upgraded her engagement ring. Mike says that Jamie also made him uninvite all of his friends and cancelled his bachelor party! Are Jamie’s antics a hint of what’s to come in their marriage? Then, Nastassia complains that her husband-to-be, Richard, is cheap. She says he wants her to buy bridal flowers from the grocery store, have her mom sew her gown and even schedule the wedding before year's end so he can get a tax write-off! Will Richard’s tightwad ways force Nastassia to call off the wedding?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when an unhealthy teen relationship threatens to tear a mother and daughter apart? Giesel says her 18-year-old daughter, Devynn, is obsessed with her boyfriend and is damaging a once promising future. Watch the drama unfold as a pregnancy scare rocks this teen's life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Three wives send their husbands to Dr. Phil's Man Camp for an attitude adjustment.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Everyone knows people that love to bicker. But what happens when the bickering escalates into verbal abuse and violence? Dr. Phil checks in with past guests Troy and Tammy whose explosive arguing is the primary dynamic in their marriage. Have they been able to break the cycle of drama or are they one step closer to divorce? Then—meet a single mother of five who worries that her children’s bickering may lead to fatal consequences! She thinks they’re out of control. So why is her daughter pointing the finger at her? Dr. Phil helps her end the fighting once and for all.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melinda and Amy claim their lives have been turned upside down by a social media influencer and political activist named Paloma, who they say has subjected them to nine months of cyberbullying and harassment. Paloma says they’ve got it all wrong and that she is the victim of their cyberbullying. Who is the real victim? Will Dr. Phil convince these three women to “log off” from each other? Find out in this explosive episode!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ask any teenager, and he or she will tell you how tough life is: schoolwork, dating and dealing with pushy parents. But imagine having two kids while you're still in high school. Dr. Phil sits down with Corey and Kim, a troubled young couple, to see if their relationship can be saved.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil tackles two news stories that have captivated millions. First up, is it ever appropriate to confront your child’s bullies? That’s what James Jones says he did when he boarded his 12-year-old daughter, Chatari’s, school bus, and the video of his tirade went viral! James says some of the students terrorized his child, who suffers from cerebral palsy, and his actions resulted in two second-degree misdemeanor charges against him. CNN contributor Roland Martin joins the show, and he says James should be named Father of the Year for protecting Chatari, who was reportedly hit, called names and had condoms thrown at her. Roland goes head-to-head with attorney Areva Martin, who says James’s behavior was unwarranted. Did this dad cross the line? What does Dr. Phil think? Plus, the disappearance of David Hartley reads like a murder mystery. His wife, Tiffany, says they were on vacation when David was shot in the head by Mexican pirates while jet skiing. His body was never recovered, and Mexican authorities question if the event really occurred. Some people wonder if Tiffany was involved, but she maintains her innocence. Find out why she declined a lie detector test, and hear Dr. Phil’s strong message for her.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: From spending $600,000 on 3-year-old beauty queens, to pushy stage sisters and an ambitious boxing coach — today's guests say they go to the extremes to help the youngest members of their family excel. Meet two fathers, one whose full-time job is managing his tiny stars' careers, and the other who hand makes each and every one of his 4-year-old daughter's costumes. Are these dads bonding with their daughters or simply pushing too hard? Plus, meet several women who defiantly criticize child beauty pageants. And, hear from one overzealous sister and the father of a boxing champion once ranked first in the world. Can Dr. Phil convince these guests to step aside and strive for balance in their children's lives?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sisters Rylie, 23, and Lenae, 26, claim their father, Leonard, was extremely physically and verbally abusive during their childhood and that they lived in constant fear of him — allegations he absolutely denies. They also claim their mother, Susan, did not protect them from him. Rylie claims the alleged abuse was so damaging that she believes it’s the cause of her diagnosis of Borderline Personality Disorder. Lenae says the many years of alleged verbal abuse have led to self-loathing and even an eating disorder. Leonard admits to having a tough disciplinary style, but refutes his daughters accusations — even saying they’ve blown everything out of proportion.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.sub-title: My Dad Was The Breast Pump Bandit (Part 1)
programme.desc: Lauren says she resents her parents, Laura and John, claiming that as a teen, Laura stole her identity and racked up $50,000 in debt – a claim Laura denies – and that John had affairs on her mom and drank alcohol and used drugs with her and her teenage friends. John admits he was the “party dad,” but claims he was just trying to bond with Lauren. But is this just the tip of the iceberg? Dr. Phil drops the bombshell that John spent nearly two years behind bars and was dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news. It’s a Dr. Phil episode you cannot miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Frankie and his former wife, Karen Leanne Dees, made headlines and were the subject of a Lifetime movie called Baby Brokers. The couple was accused of scamming would-be parents out of thousands of dollars by promising them one of their unborn babies in exchange for financial support. Frankie says he and Karen had 10 children, and he claims eight of those children were placed for adoption without his knowledge. His daughters Sandy and Ava claim their biological father not only knew about the adoption scam, but they say they believe he was the mastermind behind it. What was Frankie’s involvement? Sandy claims her biological parents “sold her like a piece of furniture for $5,000.” Find out what happens when Sandy meets her biological father for the first time.

Als man anschließend meint, Pferderennen wären Erfolg versprechender, blinzelt Jeannie - und Roger findet sich als Jockey mitten im Rennen wieder.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Tony, der selbst nicht Golf spielt, muss General Peterson auf dem Golfplatz einige dringende Papiere überbringen. Er wird von Peterson eingeladen, einige Schläge zu versuchen. Weil er von Jeannie begleitet wird, gelingen ihm natürlich die schwierigsten Schläge. Das veranlasst den begeisterten General Peterson, Tony zu seinem Partner im Match gegen Admiral Tugwell zu bestimmen - und nichts kann ihn umstimmen. Im Spiel gegen seinen Rivalen erlebt Peterson dann eine Überraschung.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie ist ein wenig enttäuscht, weil sich Tony noch nie irgendetwas so richtig Großes gewünscht hat - eine Yacht zum Beispiel. Sie fordert ihn auf, an etwas zu denken, und wenig später steht ein Elefant im Wohnzimmer. Ausgerechnet jetzt erscheint NASA-Psychiater Dr. Bellows auf der Bildfläche. Tony erklärt ihm, dass es sich bei dem Elefanten um einen Freund von ihm handelt. Es dauert nicht lange, und der neunmalkluge Psychiater braucht nichts dringender als einen Kollegen.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Bigger Than A Bread Box And Better Than A Genie
programme.desc: Die Magierin und Hellseherin Madame Zolta überrascht Roger mit Kenntnissen über seine Vergangenheit. Er und Tony werden zu einer Seance bei Madame Zolta eingeladen. Als sich Tony daran macht, die Methoden dieses Mediums zu erforschen, beschert ihm das einige überraschende Momente mit NASA-Psychiater Dr. Bellows. Als Madame Zolta in einer weiteren Seance Tonys Onkel und Tante erscheinen lässt, kommt er endgültig hinter ihren Schwindel: Tony hat keine Onkel und Tanten.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Die Air Force organisiert eine Wohltätigkeitsveranstaltung, und dafür malen die Astronauten Bilder, die versteigert werden sollen. Während Tony ein Porträt im Stile Rembrandts anfertigt, wünscht er, er könnte wie dieser malen. Er liefert sein Porträt ab, nicht ahnend, dass Jeannie es in eine exakte Kopie des Originals verwandelt hat. Als zwei Experten das Gemälde für einen echten Rembrandt halten, wird Tony verdächtigt, das Bild aus dem Louvre gestohlen zu haben.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Als das örtliche Museum Exponate aus Bukistan ausstellt, überkommt Jeannie Nostalgie, handelt es sich dabei doch um ihre alte Heimat. Als sie in der Ausstellung ein Paar Pantoffeln sieht, teilt sie Tony mit, dass diese ihr einstmals gestohlen worden waren. Ein Blinzeln von Jeannie, und die Pantoffeln sind wieder in ihrem Besitz. Tony fürchtet internationale Verwicklungen. Er bittet Jeannie, sie zurückzugeben, doch Jeannie weigert sich - und verschwindet einfach in ihrer Flasche.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Der Schah von Pakuait ist ein Öllieferant der USA. Deshalb soll seine Tochter, Prinzessin Tarji, ihren Besuch in den Staaten genießen. Um dies zu gewährleisten, wird ihr Tony als Begleiter zur Seite gestellt. Da teilt ihm Jeannie mit, dass sie Prinzessin Tarji töten muss, denn deren Familie hatte ihre Familie vor 3000 Jahren schwer beleidigt. Das wäre ja nun schon Problem genug für Tony, aber es kommt noch schlimmer: Prinzessin Tarji verliebt sich in ihn - und Jeannie sieht rot.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Als NASA-Psychiater Dr. Bellows spät in der Nacht Tony und Jeannie bei einer Feier belauscht, berichtet er wenig später Tonys Vorgesetztem, General Peterson, dass Tony eine Orgie feiert. Bis der General auftaucht, hat Jeannie längst alle Indizien beseitigt. Kurz darauf erwischt Dr. Bellows Tony in der Luft schwebend. Zwar kann Tony Dr. Bellows mit einer Erklärung abspeisen, doch von nun an versucht der Psychiater, Tony irgendwelcher obskuren Machenschaften zu überführen.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: I'll Never Forget What's Her Name
programme.desc: Tony teilt Jeannie mit, dass er eine Freundin seiner Tante ausführen muss, Miss Francine Gordon. Jeannie ist natürlich eifersüchtig. Doch dann passiert etwas, was Jeannie sehr glücklich macht: Ihr Meister verliert, als er sich am Kopf stößt, sein Gedächtnis - allerdings nur in Bezug auf Jeannie. Er hat vergessen, dass sie ein Flaschengeist ist und scheint verliebt in sie zu sein. Dann passiert das, wovon Jeannie immer schon geträumt hat: Tony macht ihr einen Heiratsantrag ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Darrin hat es wirklich nicht leicht: Nun kann sogar seine kleine Tochter Tabatha (Erin Murphy) schon zaubern, indem sie sich an der Nase reibt. Als seine Eltern ihren Besuch ansagen, bittet er Samantha, die Zauberkunst der Kleinen einstweilen stillzulegen. Samantha braucht in dieser Angelegenheit ausnahmsweise Endoras Hilfe - und das ist ein schwerer Fehler ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.sub-title: How To Fail In Business With All Kinds Of Help
programme.desc: Darrin will nicht, dass Endora ihm bei seiner Karriere unter die Arme greift.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Als sich Tante Clara eine Morgenzeitung herbeizaubert, irrt sie sich im Datum. Sie bekommt die Zeitung vom nächsten Tag. Darin steht, daß sich Larry (David White) ein Bein gebrochen hat. Darrin will diesen zukünftigen Beinbruch seines Chefs mit allen Mitteln verhindern. Doch der ist mit seiner Frau gerade im Urlaub - und alles andere als begeistert, als Darrin und Samantha auftauchen ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.sub-title: Nobody But A Frog Knows How To Live
programme.desc: Samantha geht ganz friedlich mit ihrem Töchterchen im Park spazieren, als sie von einem kleinen, dicken Mann verfolgt und angesprochen wird. Der Mann hält sie für eine Hexe und bittet um Hilfe: Er behauptet, er sei in Wirklichkeit ein Frosch, der in einen Menschen verwandelt worden ist. Und nun soll Samantha den Zauber rückgängig machen ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.sub-title: There's Gold In Them Thar Pills
programme.desc: Darrin ist erkältet. Deshalb bittet Endora den Hexenarzt Dr. Bombay, den Patient zu behandeln. Tatsächlich wirken dessen Wunderpillen unmittelbar. Begeistert wollen Darrin und Larry (David White) die Pillen kommerziell vermarkten. Nur Samantha befürchtet Komplikationen. Zu Recht, wie sich schon bald herausstellt. Denn die Pillen haben eine seltsame Nebenwirkung ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Hoher Besuch bei Samantha: Die Hexenkönigin Ticheba (Ruth McDevitt) will abdanken und hat Samantha als Nachfolgerin auserwählt. Natürlich kann Samantha diese Ehre nicht abschlagen, auch wenn es Darrin gar nicht gefällt. Samanthas erste Amtshandlung besteht darin, ihr Gefolge, das einst von Ticheba in Tiere und Gegenstände verwandelt worden war, zurückzuverwandeln. Das führt zu nicht gerade geringen Verwicklungen bei Darrins potentiellen Kunden ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Endora hat einen Zinnsoldaten zum Leben erweckt, damit er auf Tabatha (Erin Murphy) aufpasse. Doch dabei hat die Kleine zugesehen - und nun verzaubert sie alle ihre Spielsachen. Als Samantha und Darrin nach Hause kommen, ist dort die Hölle los. Endora ist die einzige, die das Spielzeug zurückverwandeln könnte - doch sie ist spurlos verschwunden ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Um einen neuen Kunden zu gewinnen, soll Darrin italienisch lernen. Weil ihm das ziemlich schwer fällt, hilft Endora ein wenig nach. Leider zaubert sie ihm die Fremdsprache so gründlich herbei, daß Darrin dabei seine Muttersprache vergißt. Kein Wunder, daß sich der umworbene Kunde nun erst recht richtig veräppelt vorkommt ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Samantha ist die große Ehre zuteil geworden, Königin aller Hexen und Hexenmeister geworden zu sein. Das paßt Darrin überhaupt nicht in den Kram. Ein Grund mehr für Endora, den ungeliebten Schwiegersohn ein für allemal loszuwerden. Endora und Serena machen sich ans Werk, als Samantha bei einem Kirchenbasar aushilft ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Als Samantha den Pelz nach Hause bringt, den sie zusammen mit Darrin in einem Schaufenster gesehen hat, reagiert dieser enttäuscht. Er wollte den Pelz seiner Frau zu Weihnachten schenken. Doch seine Enttäuschung wird mißverstanden, der Pelz zurückgebracht. Daraufhin schickt Endora die Geister der Sparsamkeit zu Darrin, der sich nun in einen unerträglichen Geizhals verwandelt. Als Samantha einschreitet, trifft ihr Großzügigkeitszauber einen Kunden Darrins ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Darrins Schwarm aus der Highschool taucht wieder auf, ausgerechnet als Samantha ihre Hexenkräfte verlassen.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Darrin versucht, einen lukrativen Werbeauftrag der Sportartikelfirma Baxter an Land zu ziehen. Doch dazu muß er sich mit Joe Baxter auf dem Golfplatz messen. Larry Tate (David White), Darrins Chef, tut alles, damit Baxter auch gewinnt. Leider haben die Golfer nicht mit einer gewissen zauberhaften Hexe gerechnet, die dem eitlen Baxter ein Lektion erteilt ...

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: Tabitha erweckt Halloween-Bilder zum Leben.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.sub-title: Out Of Sync, Out Of Mind
programme.desc: Tante Clara probiert einen Zauberspruch aus, der Samanthas Stimme verändert.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.sub-title: That Was No Chick, That Was My Wife
programme.desc: Weil Samantha gleichzeitig in Chicago und New York gesehen wird, verliert Darrin fast seinen Job.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.sub-title: Allergic To Ancient Macedonian Dodo Birds
programme.desc: Endoras Zauberkraft springt auf mysteriöse Weise auf Tante Clara über.

programme.title: Creative Crochet Corner presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: Creative Crochet Corner is an online video streaming service all about learning how to crochet! Whether you're a new to crochet just learning the basics or an experienced crocheter looking for a challenge, Creative Crochet Corner is here to help. We offer a vast library of video tutorials taught by talented crochet experts who guide you through each technique step-by-step, sharing their best tips and tricks.

programme.title: Fresh Quilting
programme.desc: Design on the surface with textures and colors. Sewing educator and modern quilter Miriam Coffey pieces embroidered fabric along with solids to create new looks for accessories and home dec. Free-motion quilt artist Christina Cameli stitches topographical spirals. Blogger and quilter Krista Fleckenstein carves custom blocks and prints customs fabric.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Are you an organized quilter or a bit on the messier side like Angela? Watch as she uses solid colors to make a tried-and-true rainbow quilt by Monique Jacobs, sharing her best organizing tips along the way.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.sub-title: Bonus: 5 Items Around Your House to Use for Quilting
programme.desc: From cornstarch to cuticle pushers, Angela shares five ingenious hacks for using common household items for quilting.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Are you a "slow and steady" quilter or more of a "forget perfect, finish fast" quilter like Angela? Tonight, she uses templates and block piecing with LOTS of triangles to create an out-of-this-world ombré quilt. Plus, she shares some handy tips for quilting with rulers.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: Designer Wyatt White shows how to use a special bracelet jig to create fun and fashionable wire bangles and custom wire components. In her Beading Lesson, Katie braids knitted wire tubing and strings it together with stones and fibers to make a chunky multi-strand necklace.

programme.title: Scrapbook Soup
programme.desc: Sweeten favorite family photos. Cheryl Boglioli goes beyond the frame by adding tags to framed photos and then shares a special tip. Ashley Horton creates a fun page for her sister. Amy Tan preserves special family memories with artistic techniques the whole family can enjoy together.

programme.title: Make It Artsy
programme.desc: Your home is a gallery for your art. Artist Dina Wakley makes a wall hanging with tissue stamping. Tool expert Joe Rotella uses computer design and cutting technology to create an apron. Using watercolors, calligrapher Janet Takahashi creates simple brush lettering. Author Rebekah Meier has a tip for adding a splash of color to any home.

programme.title: Working with Difficult Fabric
programme.sub-title: National Sewing Circle presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: Learn to sew, step-by-step with National Sewing Circle experts on CraftsyTV.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Ready to find your center? Tonight, Angela becomes one with the piecing as she makes a stress-relieving half-square triangle quilt.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: On the season finale of Season 6 of the Midnight Quilt Show, follow along as Angela shares her clever take on a braided quilt pattern she created herself!

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Holy scrap. Quilting can get a little messy sometimes, especially when you're busting your scrap stash. But nothing's gonna stop Angela from making room for new fabric! Feel the same? Your stitching sidekick awaits. (She's even sharing the free quilt pattern!)

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: It was only a matter of time before the Midnight Quilt Show tackled Janice Ryan's Wallflower Quilt! You bring the wine, Angela's got the Flying Geese covered.

programme.title: Craft Hacks
programme.desc: Time-saving quick tips to feed your crafting craving.

programme.title: Butter Book
programme.desc: Learn to bake and cook with CraftsyTV.

programme.title: Knit Meets Knot
programme.sub-title: The Knitting Circle Presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: Learn to knit, step-by-step with The Knitting Circle experts on CraftsyTV.

programme.title: Woodworkers Guild of America presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: Learn about dovetail joinery techniques with George Vondriska's expert guidance. He'll discuss the difference between half-blind dovetails and through dovetails so you can talk the talk before you make your first cut. Then, George dives into the anatomy of your dovetail jig and router before demonstrating best practices when it comes to creating your dovetail joins.

programme.title: It's Sew Easy
programme.sub-title: The World at War, Again - The 1940's
programme.desc: Factories hummed and women took up men's roles making military supplies as the second World War began. Fabric was rationed and women took fashion cues from military uniforms. Angela Wolf makes a contemporary jacket inspired by General Eisenhower's shortened uniform jacket. Embroidery expert Lisa Shaw shows how to design a handy embroidered clutch bag for an evening out.

programme.title: Off Our Needles
programme.desc: Get ready for the newest knit-along! Tracie and Jodi show off their finished Novel-Ts and talk sizing, yarn and lace.

programme.title: SCANIA KNIT ALONG IV: I-Cord + Easiest-Ever Magic" Fringe"
programme.desc: And now, for the moment you've all been waiting for: the unraveling of the fringe! Learn all about the I-cord bind-off, pull out some stitches, and get ready to show off your Scania Shawl.

programme.title: Hands On Crafts for Kids
programme.desc: Every day is play time! Challenge your skills with an ice cream cone ball toss game. Design your own indoor miniature golf course with Franz, then put on a show with puppets Jenny shows how to make and decorate. Add some cardboard to the Family Craft Box to create a super mask and make your own superhero figure.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: Die-cut shapes open new possibilities for jewelry-making. Inventor and jewelry-maker Jill McKay cuts leather in various sizes to create colorful stacking shapes. Katie use aurora borealis beads to accent a beaded fringe pendant for a rich, sparkly look.

programme.title: Beads, Baubles & Jewels
programme.desc: Shape makes the style statement. Designer syndee holt builds style from the bottom up as she creates no-show bezels for polymer clay jewelry. Then, she uses clay to make a seamless custom bail. In her Beading Lesson, Katie Hacker combines suede, chain and beads for a trendy new look.

programme.title: Scrapbook Soup
programme.desc: Titles start the story. Calligrapher Joanne Fink creates luscious lettering and Julie Fei-Fan Balzer shares her favorite title ideas. Christine Drumheller has a tip for making mini-albums and Ashley Horton lets loose with foils and colors to create attention- grabbing titles.

programme.title: Make It Artsy
programme.desc: Your home is a gallery for your art. Artist Dina Wakley makes a wall hanging with tissue stamping. Tool expert Joe Rotella uses computer design and cutting technology to create an apron. Using watercolors, calligrapher Janet Takahashi creates simple brush lettering. Author Rebekah Meier has a tip for adding a splash of color to any home.

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show
programme.desc: Angela whips up a stash-busting table topper using the quilt-as-you-go method Gudrun Erla teaches in her online class "Fast & Furious: Quilt-As-You-Go With Pre-Cuts."

programme.title: The Midnight Quilt Show

programme.title: Sri Lanka - Tropics, temples and tea plantations
programme.desc: Sri Lanka stands for colourful diversity in all respects. If it's spirituality or Ayurveda you're looking for, here it is. Adventurers and nature lovers can also satisfy their needs here. No one must travel far to discover exotic worlds on this drop-shaped tropical island. "mareTV" delves into the day to day lives of the is-landers, some of whom pursue the most unusual pro-fessions: Uditha Lakmaal is a palm tree climber. He harvests the sap of the trees, known as palm wine, by climbing to the top of them. Sri Lankan stilt fishermen now actually have very little to do with fish and func-tion more as models receiving payment from tourists for acting the part. Anulawathie runs a small floating hoop business, offering car inner tubes for adults and tuk-tuk tubes for children. Different varieties of tea can be found on Herman Gunaratnes tea plantation. Just four carefully selected women are allowed to harvest the exclusive white tea grown there. Each tea leaf is cut individually from the bush by gloved hands and with golden scissors.

programme.title: Wild Faces of the Andes
programme.desc: The Andes are the biggest mountain range in the world. Peaks of up to 7000 metres in height, do not only offer an imposing view, but also influence the climate by being the drainage and meteorological divide.

programme.title: Germany's Mystic Forest
programme.desc: 2.000 rivers and streams dig deep into the underground and transport their water into reservoirs or "Germany's Wild Amazon", the Wupper. These forests and rivers, together with heathlands and moors, are home to a diverse fauna. Martens, badgers, wild boars, hares, roe deer, and red deer, even black grouse and hazel deer find shelter in these parts. Wolves also have a dominant presence, not to mention those who live underground, such as lizards, bats, and snakes. Accompany us on a journey where we explore every corner of this rugged land. Climb underground into the Bergisches Land, through the vast hidden cave systems that sprawl far beneath the forests. There is also much to be discovered in the water, dive with us in crystal clear streams and rivers with their diverse flora and fauna.

programme.title: Magical Moors
programme.desc: Wide open heaths, windswept and barren in winter, are transformed into wonderful carpets of white, fluffy cotton grass in summer. Large bears and wolves roam alongside delicately fluttering butterflies, the bubbling calls of black grouse and the enchanting trills of the great snipe. Moors, bogs and wetlands can be found all over in Europe. Everyone has at least heard about this habitat but most know little about it. It is an ancient yet largely unknown set of landscapes that is full of enchanting surprises. On a warm spring day, poisonous adders emerge from hiding to perform their impressive mating dance. As dusk falls, snipe gather on traditional leks, leaping and singing to impress the opposite sex. And deep down in the boggy marshes, glittering emeralds of sticky dew lure insects into the deadly arms of meat-eating plants. Magical Moors captures the quiet beauty of a spectacular landscape, and its often elusive wildlife, in stunning detail.

programme.title: Masai Mara: The Big Hunt
programme.desc: When food supply in the Serengeti dwindles, the Masai Mara is a paradise for predators. As the black wildebeests, gazelles, zebras and antelopes make their yearly trip from the south of the Serengeti to the north, nature’s best laid trap, the Mara River in Kenya is waiting ahead. Captivating shots filmed under water show how crocodiles prepare for the Big Hunt while other predators lurk on the banks awaiting their bounty. The biggest problems for the migratory animals are the Mara and the Tarek River, where they have to put their lives at risk to get to the other side. A great number of them die as they jump into the river and break their legs, while others are carried away by the drift or drown. Those who are not victims of the river itself risk falling prey to the crocodiles. We entered this unchartered territory, the crocodile domain by heading under water. Follow these predators in and around their habitat and watch prides of lions map out their game plan. In slow-motion, we show you the final showdown between predator and prey. Will it be a successful hunt or will the hoofed animals persevere?

programme.title: Penguin City - South Georgia
programme.desc: In the middle of the Antarctic Ocean, an entire mountain range arises from the water: South Georgia, the nursery of the Antarctic. Hundreds of thousands of penguins, elephant seals, fur seals and their young overcrowd the beaches. The rough weather and the extremely difficult access to the island cause filmmaking to be an endeavor requiring much of the film crew around Roland Gockel and Rosie Koch and the state of the art cameras. A lot of patience and sensitivity over a period spanning some five years now offers unknown and poignant insights into the life of the King Penguins on South Georgia Island

programme.title: Over the Islands of Africa
programme.sub-title: Over the Islands of Africa, Zanzibar
programme.desc: Photographer Matthias Ziegler is an Africa specialist. He has visited nearly every country on the continent on assignments for international agencies. Zanzibar, however, is new territory for him. He's come to the former slave island for a photo book – and this time he's not alone. To see the Tanzanian archipelago from the air, he has enlisted the services of ultralight pilot Richard Meredith-Hardy of England to fly him around in his FIB, or flying inflatable boat. Perfect conditions for an adventurous journey: as a world champion ultralight pilot, Richard and his FIB can take off and land practically anywhere – in theory.

programme.title: Over the Islands of Africa
programme.sub-title: Over the Islands of Africa, Mauritius
programme.desc: Renaud Van Der Meeren is a photographer and paramotor pilot. With his motorised parachute he goes on expeditions to the remotest corners on earth to photograph people and landscapes from the air. Renaud wanted to be a jet pilot, studied music at the Sorbonne, became a ski instructor, model and photographer's assistant before he found happiness in his current vocation. He especially likes to do his job in Mauritius – nowhere else does he find so many motifs as on the "sweetest pearl in the Indian Ocean". This time he's working on a photo book about Mauritius – by land, by water and in the air.

programme.title: Eyes Of The Atacama
programme.desc: ALMA – the Atacama Large Millimeter Array – is the ultimate space observation facility. Here, 66 leviathan parabolic antennae trap cosmic rays in the previously unobservable long-wave range. It can only happen in Atacama, far away from civilisation’s pollution of the night sky with artificial light.

programme.title: The Sun - Inferno in the Sky
programme.desc: On July 23rd, 2012, a massive eruption on the sun hurls a colossal cloud of solar matter into space. It’s the most severe sunstorm in 150 years. Fortunately, the Earth is not in the direct path of this solar ejection. But it’s only a matter of time before a violent solar storm hits us. When these clouds of charged matter reach our planet, they can wreak havoc in electrical systems.

programme.title: Deadly Roads

Documentary filmmaker Oliver G. Becker ventured onto the dangerous roads of Afghanistan's Hindu Kush Mountains, the infamous Moloto Road in South Africa, along the vertiginous slopes of the Bolivian Andes and other "roads of death" in India, Georgia and the Ivory Coast

programme.title: Deadly Roads
programme.desc: Some risks on these autoroutes have natural causes: Extreme weather, avalanches and landslides. In some areas, the locals even believe that evil spirits kill travelers. But many of the dangers are man-made: robbers or terrorists lie in wait for travelers, and tough labor pressures, social hardship and greedy mass-transit businesses also cause tragic driving accidents around the world. In the 20th century alone, 35 million people died on roads worldwide - plus 1.5 billion injured! With the two-part "Death Roads - On the Road at the Limit," phoenix offers a documentary road movie along the world's most dangerous car routes.

programme.title: New Life
programme.desc: It's a water world and life couldn't survive without it. And thanks to it, a mind blowing diversity of creatures thrive beneath the surface. Born to enjoy the riches underwater they must master their body's adaptations, learn to find food, to escape danger and above all become expert swimmers! Whether it's in rivers, on beaches or in the deep ocean, all must overcome the obstacles and fulfil their destiny, all are born to swim! Of all the habitats on earth, the ocean is perhaps the most challenging. Here salt, temperatures, currents and predators can make life difficult; it's not an obvious place to want to bring up your babies… But even in these waters generation after generation beats the odds. They have overcome the challenges and become some of the most beautiful and graceful of creatures. But any baby born to swim has a lot to learn… All over the world there are creatures born to swim, and though humans are not, we seem determined to join them. Perhaps we are envious of their grace. Maybe we are all water babies at heart

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.sub-title: The Psychogramm of a Spiritual Landscape
programme.desc: The Bohemian Forest is the source of the Vltava River, home to primeval forests, untouched high moors and bubbling torrents. This archaic stretch of land, which includes the Bavarian Forest, was long considered impenetrable and mysterious. Since the fall of the Iron Curtain, Bavarian border residents have rediscovered new references to this unusual forest landscape for themselves. This is also the case with photo artist Bastian Kalous, who has been documenting his homeland for years with nostalgic-looking Polaroid photographs and is dealing with its eventful history for an illustrated book. Or Elisa Belotti and Marco Heurich, who have dedicated their lives to the lynxes. In order for Europe's largest wild cat to survive in the Bohemian Forest, the lynx researchers fight for every single animal. Iryna Rudenko came to Zwiesel from Ukraine out of a passion for glass as a material to study at the glass school. After graduation, she would like to stay in Bavaria, Anna Hones grew up in Horská Kvilda, the smallest and highest village in the Czech Republic. The village lies just under 1100 meters above sea level, directly on the former border. The farmer, who experienced communism, the fall of the Iron Curtain and the subsequent changes, is now trying to find ways of surviving in this barren region with her children.
